deep_dive.title: PACT: NVFP4 Data-Flow LoRA Fine-Tuning on Consumer GPUs
deep_dive.abstract: Fine-tuning language models on consumer GPUs is constrained by computation and memory. Although LoRA reduces trainable parameters and optimizer state, frozen projections remain expensive, and activations retained for backward can dominate memory usage. We present PACT, a LoRA fine-tuning system that accelerates frozen projections with native NVFP4 GEMMs while reducing quantization and dequantization overhead and limiting quantization error. To reduce activation memory, PACT reuses quantized RMSNorm outputs and saves gate/up activations in NVFP4 for backward. To limit numerical error, it preserves BF16 inputs for forward nonlinear operations and calibrates frozen weights offline using GPTQ adapted to NVFP4 scales and quantized activations. Fused nonlinear kernels and cached forward and backward weight layouts reduce quantization and dequantization overhead. Evaluations across multiple models and tasks on a 16\,GB RTX~5080 show lower memory usage and faster LoRA fine-tuning with competitive accuracy, enabling model adaptation on resource-constrained consumer hardware.

deep_dive.llm_tldr_en: PACT makes LoRA fine-tuning feasible on consumer GPUs by running frozen projections in native NVFP4 GEMMs, storing backward activations in NVFP4, and calibrating frozen weights offline with a GPTQ variant adapted to NVFP4 scales and quantized activations.
deep_dive.llm_tldr_cn: 在消费级GPU上微调语言模型受限于算力与显存，LoRA虽减少可训练参数，但冻结投影的计算与反向激活存储仍开销巨大。PACT提出一种NVFP4数据流LoRA微调系统，用原生NVFP4 GEMM加速冻结投影，复用RMSNorm量化输出并以NVFP4保存门控与上投影激活以降低激活内存，同时用适配NVFP4尺度的GPTQ离线校准冻结权重以抑制量化误差。该工作将量化与低秩适配结合，在降低量化与反量化开销的同时保持数值精度。
